acceptance: The model-classifier launch resolves its CLI order through internal/cliroute (one Resolve per classification, or the table's declared clis order) and classifierCLIPreference is deleted; red first: a table with clis [agy, claude] never launches codex to classify

docs/plans/cli-routing-table-2026-10.md lists the model-classifier launch (cmd/evolve/cmd_models_live.go: liveRefresh -> tierClassifier -> pickClassifierCLI -> bridgePromptDispatcher) in the L1b 'Every launch path calls Resolve' table, and the source-scan guard covers it
The /model picker capture of evolve models refresh and evolve setup latest (bridgeModelCapturer) probes only families the table's clis declares
Under the operator's table (L2), evolve setup detect no longer reports codex ready from a stale auth file, and evolve models refresh neither lists nor classifies on codex
The plan's L2 config list drops agy-tmux.json model_tier_map fast/balanced: it moved to Gemini 3.8 Flash on 2026-10-05 (branch fix/model-refresh-classifier-and-agy-flash-3-8)

consumed.resolution: CLI routing L1b (ADR-0119): the model classifier resolves its CLI order through internal/cliroute (Request{Agent: model-classifier, Launch: classifier}); classifierCLIPreference is deleted and its codex > claude > agy order is the legacy projection; TestClassifierOrder_ComesFromTheRoutingTable pins that a table with clis [agy, claude] never classifies on codex; the launch is in the plan's L1b wiring and held by TestOnlyCliRouteBuildsChains. The detect and picker halves under the operator's table are L2 (item 6/8).

fix: In L1b, build the classifier chain from the routing table instead of the classifierCLIPreference Go literal: tierClassifier asks the Router for the model-classifier agent's chain (or the declared clis in order) and keeps only CLIs with a headless classifier driver (codex, claude-p, agy). Add the launch to the plan's L1b launch-path table so the TestOnlyCliRouteBuildsChains guard holds it. L2's clis then removes codex from detect, the picker probe and the classifier for this operator.
source: console, 2026-10-05, lane dev/cl-models38 (evolve models refresh never picked agy's Gemini 3.8 Flash)
summary: evolve models refresh classifies every family's model ids on one of the ready CLIs, ordered by the classifierCLIPreference Go literal (codex > claude > agy) in cmd/evolve/cmd_models_live.go. That is a launch path outside the CLI routing table (internal/cliroute, ADR-0119, PR #770): the table's clis cannot remove codex from it. On 2026-10-05 setup detect called codex ready from a stale auth file although the operator has no codex subscription, so codex was the classifier, its launch failed, and every family fell back to its detect map. The lane added a fallback chain over the ready CLIs (modelquery.ChainClassifier), but the order is still the Go literal and codex is still tried first. The routing table's clis fixes the detect half in L2.
title: The model-classifier launch resolves its CLI through the CLI routing table
